verdict.rationale: User found spec incomplete: (1) missing root cause that buildFocusedChatSidebarViewModel only receives chats+assistantFolders, not chatFolders, so empty custom folders never appear in Focused mode groups; (2) handleCreateFolder must expand Focused's isGroupsExpanded, not just Unified's isFoldersExpanded; (3) clicking an empty custom folder in Focused root must open drill-down with an empty state, not crash/bounce; FocusedAggregateRow needs a no-chats line; (4) empty folders sort by timestamp 0, no reordering in scope; (5) tests must cover view-model behavior for empty custom vs import/workflow folders, folder-appears-after-create, and empty-folder drill-down — not just button presence.

The claim that raw folder names naturally classify as custom is false: getFolderKindFromKey returns legacy-import for names recognized by getLegacyImportGroupName and legacy-avatar for AVATAR_CHAT_FOLDER, so empty ones would wrongly surface as groups. Also dedup by raw name fails for import folders (chats keyed import:<source>/legacy-import:<name>, creating an empty twin) and for assistant-named folders (their chats merge into the assistant group via isAssistantNameFolder, not sourceFolderChats, so both an assistant group and an empty duplicate custom folder would show). Fix: reuse Unified's normalization (map through sidebarFolderKeyFromName, keep only kind===custom, skip names already represented by a folder group or an assistant group, skip AVATAR_CHAT_FOLDER), extracted into a shared helper used by both useChatSidebarFolders and the Focused view model rather than duplicated. Add unit tests for: empty legacy-import-named folder produces no group; chatFolders entry named after an assistant with chats produces no extra custom group; import folder with chats plus same raw name in chatFolders produces exactly one group.
User approved after two rounds of source-verified corrections to the Focused-mode view-model fix and its folder-classification/dedup handling.

Two fixes needed: (1) Task 2 dedup rule misses new-style imports — chats with import_source key as import:<source> in sourceFolderChats while chat.folder can be any non-legacy name, so an empty twin can appear next to the import group; same gap for imported chats skipped via isImportedChat. Replace the not-a-sourceFolderChats-key + not-an-assistant-name checks with: build a Set of every chat.folder from the input chats, synthesize an empty group only when kind==='custom' AND name not in that Set AND name!==AVATAR_CHAT_FOLDER — covers imports, legacy imports, assistant-name folders and raw-name dedup in one rule. Add test: chat with importSource set and folder 'My Claude export' (non-legacy name) + chatFolders entry 'My Claude export' -> exactly one (import) group. (2) Task 4 breaks mutual exclusivity — Focused's Recent/Workflows default expanded and are local state; lifting isGroupsExpanded=true from handleCreateFolder leaves Recent/Workflows/Folders all open at once (handleToggleGroups never allows that), and lifted state would wrongly survive Unified<->Focused switches. Do NOT lift isGroupsExpanded. Instead add prop expandFoldersSignal: number to FocusedChatSidebar; a useEffect on it (skipping the initial value) applies the same expand branch as handleToggleGroups (groups=true, recent=false, workflowRuns=false). ChatSidebarLists holds the counter; handleCreateFolder increments it via a setter passed through UseChatSidebarSectionsParams. Add test: in Focused mode with Recent expanded, create a folder -> Folders expanded AND Recent + Workflows collapsed.

User approved after fixing the dedup rule (single Set-based check covering imports/legacy-imports/assistant-names) and dropping the lifted-state approach for Task 4 in favor of an expandFoldersSignal prop.
